test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Pandemic is the highest level of global health emergency and had signifies widespread outbreaks affecting multiple regions of the world.

options.text: outbreaks affecting multiple regions of the world.
Pandemic is the highest level of global
health emergency and had signifies widespread

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the **incorrect use** of the word "**had**" before "**signifies**."
 
• The correct form should be "**signifies**" without the auxiliary verb** "had".**
 
• The correct phrase should be "**health emergency and signifies widespread**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Pandemic is the highest level of global** health emergency and signifies widespread** outbreaks affecting multiple regions of the world."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 4.
 
• **Option 2: "outbreaks affecting multiple regions of the world."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "Pandemic is the highest level of global"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "health emergency and had signifies widespread,"** – This part of the sentence contains the error as explained above.
